en.archive.enableHint: Save user input and model output (default off).
en.archive.failed: Save failed: host refused or write incomplete.
en.archive.hint1: User input first writes to disk successfully then passes; model output saved after generation, before next model send and summarization. Write failure blocks related requests; can retry, change directory, or explicitly disable archive and continue.
en.archive.hint2: Switching directory does not migrate old files; old directory retained for retrospective. In-session uses conversation_archive for search and pagination; streams lost before enabling cannot be recovered.
en.archive.invalidPath: Not saved: enabling archive requires an absolute directory path.
en.archive.retrySubmitted: Retry request submitted; write success see /token-status.
en.archive.saved: Archive settings saved; subsequent inputs checked per this config, write status see /token-status.
en.archive.unconfirmed: Save result unconfirmed, verify and retry.
en.controller.notReady: Current config not yet fetched; below are default reference values, not editable.
en.hint.dataLoss: Tool history cleanup hides some historical results; model summarization may lose detail; ability to review original text does not mean lossless.
en.hint.defaults: Keep current defaults, do not auto-enable layered. After disabling auto-compression here, host still retains its safety compression.
en.hint.layeredOnly: Layered thresholds only apply in layered strategy; legacy driver also limited by min turns and token volume.
en.hint.tokenStatus: Trigger reasons, attempts/successes, before/after estimates, and error causes for current session: use /token-status.
en.status.failed: Save failed: host refused or write incomplete.
en.status.modified: After changes, entire group is saved; takes effect on next check.
en.status.notReady: Settings service not ready; use /token-status to view running state.
en.status.saved: Saved; next check will use new config, ongoing operations continue with old config.
en.status.unconfirmed: Save result unconfirmed, verify applied values and retry.
en.strategy.label: Auto-Compression Strategy
en.strategy.layered: Layered (Clean Tool History First, Then Attempt Summarization)
en.validation.thresholds: Not saved: must satisfy 0 < observation ≤ cleanup < summarization < 100%; legacy driver threshold also must be in 0%–100% range.

zh.archive.enableHint: 保存用户原文与模型输出（默认关闭）。
zh.archive.failed: 保存失败：宿主拒绝或未完成写入。
zh.archive.hint1: 用户原文先写盘成功再放行；模型输出生成后保存，后续送模和摘要前确认。写盘失败会阻止相关请求，可重试、改目录，或明确关闭归档后继续。
zh.archive.hint2: 切换目录不搬迁旧文件；旧目录保留为回查来源。会话内使用 conversation_archive 按需搜索和分页读取；开启前丢失的流片段无法补录。
zh.archive.invalidPath: 未保存：启用归档必须填写绝对目录路径。
zh.archive.retrySubmitted: 已提交重试；写盘是否成功请查看 /token-status。
zh.archive.saved: 已保存归档设置；后续输入按此配置检查，写盘状态请查看 /token-status。
zh.archive.unconfirmed: 保存结果未确认，请核对后重试。
zh.controller.notReady: 尚未取得当前配置；以下为默认参考值，不可编辑。
zh.hint.dataLoss: 工具历史清理会遮蔽部分历史结果；模型摘要可能丢失细节，能够回查原文也不等于无损。
zh.hint.defaults: 保留当前默认值，不自动启用分层。关闭此处的自动压缩后，宿主仍保留自身的安全压缩。
zh.hint.layeredOnly: 分层阈值仅在分层策略下生效；旧驱动还受最少轮数与 token 量限制。
zh.hint.tokenStatus: 当前会话的触发原因、尝试/成功、前后估算量与异常原因：使用 /token-status。
zh.status.failed: 保存失败：宿主拒绝或未完成写入。
zh.status.modified: 修改后整组保存；下一次检查生效。
zh.status.notReady: 设置服务未就绪；可用 /token-status 查看运行状态。
zh.status.readOnly: 当前配置只读，无法保存。
zh.status.saved: 已保存；下一次压缩检查采用新配置，正在执行的操作沿用原配置。
zh.status.unconfirmed: 保存结果未确认，请核对生效值后重试。
zh.strategy.label: 自动压缩策略
zh.strategy.layered: 分层（先清理工具历史，再尝试摘要）
zh.validation.thresholds: 未保存：须满足 0 < 观测线 ≤ 清理线 < 摘要线 < 100%；旧驱动阈值也须在 0% 与 100% 之间。
